title: A black box, three colored shapes and a lot of logos that were not 3DO’s
label: Brand gallery
lede: The machines carried their makers’ names: Panasonic, Goldstar. 3DO’s own identity lived on the box corner and, later, on game cases. These are free-licensed photographs, two archived pages and our own drawings.

archive.caption: Panasonic’s FZ-1 R.E.A.L. 3DO Interactive Multiplayer with its controller, the first 3DO machine.
Goldstar’s 3DO machine, on sale in the United States by December 1994.[^23]
